note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI sent Burna Boyz Alpha to a far backfield corner to screen, when it could advance toward the empty center objective. The screen move wastes the unit's turn. Fix: Make screen_base depend on a real threat. It should be at least the distance to the nearest enemy that could reach the screened unit. Cap or drop it when no enemy is within 1 move plus 12 in of the screened area. Let the best-scoring objective option replace an assigned screen role when the screen score is below the objective score. Do not apply the home-objective race override to other objectives.
